ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER P

Letter P — Penguin.

A waddling penguin arrives for the letter P. P pops like a small bubble — and penguins are the bounciest, most huggable pop in the animal kingdom.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does P say?

“p — puh, a tiny pop”

P says puh — a tiny pop made with your lips, like a soap bubble bursting. Say puh into your child’s hand so they feel the little puff of air.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Penguin waddle.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Waddle around the room with a book (or a small cushion) balanced on your head: puh, puh, penguin.

  2. 02

    Carry a pretend egg on your feet — three slow steps is a triumph.

  3. 03

    Finish huddled together like a penguin family, flippers out.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
